Name: FarmNet
Author: LennyTheFreakOG
Description:
FarmNet
A real web browser inside Stardew Valley.
FarmNet brings a fully functional, Chromium-based web browser directly into Stardew Valley.
Browse the internet, search for information, watch YouTube, listen to browser audio, and even play compatible WebGL games without leaving your game.
Whether you're looking something up, watching a video while working on your farm, or just exploring the internet, FarmNet gives you a little computer right inside the Valley.
[heading]Features[/heading]
Full Web Browser
[list]
[*]Browse real websites using an embedded Chromium browser.[/*]
[*]Enter URLs directly into the address bar.[/*]
[*]Search the internet.[/*]
[*]Back, forward, and reload navigation.[/*]
[*]Mouse and keyboard support.[/*]
[*]Page scrolling and text input.[/*]
[*]Built-in browser caching.[/*]
[/list]Multi-Tab Browsing
[list]
[*]Open multiple browser tabs.[/*]
[*]Switch between tabs without losing your place.[/*]
[*]Each tab maintains its own browsing session.[/*]
[*]Automatically restore previously open tabs when reopening FarmNet.[/*]
[*]Closing a tab removes it from your saved browser session.[/*]
[/list]Media and Audio
[list]
[*]YouTube video playback.[/*]
[*]Browser audio playback.[/*]
[*]Automatic Stardew Valley music ducking while browser audio is playing.[/*]
[*]Audio management designed to work alongside the game's own sound.[/*]
[/list]Custom Interface
[list]
[*]Pixel-art interface designed to fit Stardew Valley.[/*]
[*]Dark and Stardew-inspired parchment themes.[/*]
[*]Movable browser window: click and drag the window to reposition it.[/*]
[*]Resizable browser window: hover over the bottom-right corner, then click and drag to adjust its size.[/*]
[*]Address bar and browser navigation controls.[/*]
[*]Bookmark support.[/*]
[*]Popup handling for supported websites.[/*]
[/list]WebGL Support
FarmNet can run compatible browser-based games and applications.
Yes, you can actually play browser games inside Stardew Valley.
For example, you can visit and play JACK'S — AIM TRAINER directly through FarmNet.
Smartphone Integration
FarmNet also includes integration with the supported Smartphone mod, bringing browser functionality into the in-game phone experience.
[heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install FarmNet and its included files.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load your save.[/*]
[*]Press [b]F2[/b] to open FarmNet.[/*]
[/list]Use your mouse and keyboard normally while the browser is open.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.x[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.x[/*]
[*]Windows 64-bit[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility and Limitations[/heading]
FarmNet uses an embedded Chromium browser, but not every website is guaranteed to work perfectly.
Some websites may have compatibility issues, restrictions, or features that do not behave as they would in a standalone browser.
Video playback and other website-specific functionality can vary depending on the site.
An internet connection is required to browse online content.
[heading]Credits[/heading]
FarmNet is created by [b]LennyTheFreakOG[/b].
Built using:
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]CefSharp / Chromium[/*]
[*]NAudio[/*]
[/list][heading]Support FarmNet[/heading]
If you're enjoying FarmNet, please consider giving the project an [b]endorsement and a vote[/b] on Nexus Mods!
Sharing the mod with friends or other Stardew Valley players also helps tremendously.
I'm an independent developer, and every endorsement, vote, comment, and bit of support genuinely helps motivate me to keep improving the project.
Thanks for giving FarmNet a try and being part of its development. I really appreciate it!
[b]— LennyTheFreakOG[/b]
